paragraphs.text: The Eye of Doom or Doombringer was the blue moon of Mirrodin , composed of blue mana . It shone over the Quicksilver Sea .

The Goblins of Mirrodin are only barely able to perceive the sun because their eyesight skews towards infrared wavelengths. To them the sun has a ghostly, almost invisible presence. Goblins born under the Eye of Doom were thrown into the Great Furnace .
It now orbits Zhalfir after New Phyrexia's phasing out at the end of the New Phyrexian Invasion .
